Use the four actual bounded-below derived functors, their four single-complex coefficient objects, and typed unshifted tails. The theorem rawModuleScalar_coefficient_unshifted supplies their unshifted equality.

Apply the existing private shift_square to the four derived functors and unshifted tails. NatTrans.shift_app_comm, the shift-comparison naturality, functoriality, and associativity transport the identity to every integer shift. Unfolding the three unchanged concrete coefficient factors identifies its shifted tails with the goal.

Construct the generic shift_square application from the actual typed functors and unshifted tails. Use the existing higherDirectImageRawOverComplex_eq equations to compare named raw complexes with their single-complex endpoint presentations. A private congruence helper constructs ordinary HEq congruences, unfolds local abbreviations, instantiates assigned metavariables and matches equivalent universe expressions before expanding large derived-category structures. Proof irrelevance identifies proof fields. The final Eq term is checked by Lean’s kernel and adds no mathematical premise. Build heterogeneous symmetry and transitivity directly with Lean proof constructors, avoiding repeated elaborator unification of the large derived-category endpoints.
